_comment: Recorded agent replies for `briefkasten demo finanzamt_bescheid`. Redaction, deadline maths, verification and approval all run live.

triage.reasoning: Income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) with a Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung; it demands a payment but no reply.

explainer.summary_en: This is your income tax assessment for 2025 from the tax office. They set your income tax at 8,412.00 €. Your employer already withheld 8,000.00 € from your salary, so you owe another 412.00 €. They only accepted part of your home-office costs, because you did not show that the home office is the centre of all your work.
key_points: You must pay 412.00 € by 16.11.2026 and quote your tax number (Steuernummer) with the payment.
Home-office costs were only allowed at the daily flat rate of 6 € per day, up to 1,260 €.
You can object (Einspruch) within one month of the date the decision counts as delivered.
An objection on its own does not postpone the payment; you can ask for a suspension (Aussetzung der Vollziehung) of the disputed amount.
explainer.if_ignored: The assessment becomes final after the objection period, and the 412.00 € remains due.

drafter.subject_de: Einspruch gegen den Bescheid für 2025 über Einkommensteuer und Solidaritätszuschlag vom 13.10.2026, Steuernummer [STEUERNUMMER_1]
drafter.body_de:
Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,

hiermit lege ich Einspruch gegen den oben genannten Bescheid vom 13.10.2026 ein.

Begründung:
Die Aufwendungen für mein häusliches Arbeitszimmer wurden nur in Höhe der Tagespauschale berücksichtigt. Das Arbeitszimmer bildet jedoch den Mittelpunkt meiner gesamten beruflichen Tätigkeit. [Nachweis beifügen, z. B. Bestätigung des Arbeitgebers]

Ich beantrage, die Aufwendungen für das Arbeitszimmer in voller Höhe zu berücksichtigen und die Steuer entsprechend herabzusetzen. Zugleich beantrage ich die Aussetzung der Vollziehung in Höhe des streitigen Betrags.
drafter.body_en:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I hereby object to the above decision dated 13.10.2026.

Reasons:
The costs of my home office were only accepted at the daily flat rate. However, the home office is the centre of all my professional activity. [Attach evidence, e.g. a confirmation from my employer]

I request that the home-office costs be accepted in full and the tax reduced accordingly. I also request suspension of enforcement for the disputed amount.
drafter.notes_en: Attach proof that the home office is the centre of your work, and remember that the objection alone does not stop the 412.00 € payment from being due.
